Boxing Federation Chief Suspends Secretary General Amid Power Struggle

The Boxing Federation of India (BFI) chief, Ajay Singh, has suspended secretary general Pramod Kumar. This action follows Kumar's move to initiate a no-confidence motion against Singh. The suspension was reportedly due to allegations of financial irregularities, and it occurred a day after Kumar had lodged an intimidation complaint with Prime Minister Narendra Modi.
